class.name: ColorGrade
class.brief_description: A look for the picture, which [ColorGradeVolume3D]s blend in.
class.description: Exposure, brightness, contrast, saturation, a tint and a color lookup table: what a place, a time of day or a weather does to the picture. Give it to a [ColorGradeVolume3D]. Everything but [member exposure] is applied as the [Environment]'s adjustments are, after tonemapping; a tint or lookup table is blended into one lookup table with the environment's own.

members.member: Times the environment's own [member Environment.tonemap_exposure]: below [code]1[/code] darker, above brighter.
A color lookup table, as [member Environment.adjustment_color_correction] takes one: a [Texture3D] with red across, green down and blue through its layers. Its data must be readable.
The picture's saturation, as [member Environment.adjustment_saturation]: [code]0[/code] is black and white.
A color the picture is multiplied by, after tonemapping.
